published_has_timestamp_and_approver.name: published_has_timestamp_and_approver
published_has_timestamp_and_approver.value:
"information_item"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'updated')
          OR ("information_item"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL
              AND "information_item"."published_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "information_item"."assessment" IS NOT NULL)

polled_sources_have_a_feed_url.name: polled_sources_have_a_feed_url
polled_sources_have_a_feed_url.value: "source"."kind" NOT IN ('rss', 'api') OR "source"."feed_url" IS NOT NULL

restricted_material_is_not_linked.name: restricted_material_is_not_linked
restricted_material_is_not_linked.value:
"evidence"."data_class" NOT IN ('restricted', 'secret')
          OR ("evidence"."url" IS NULL AND "evidence"."blob_url" IS NULL)

resolved_queue_entry_is_attributed.name: resolved_queue_entry_is_attributed
resolved_queue_entry_is_attributed.value:
"review_queue"."state" NOT IN ('done', 'dropped')
          OR ("review_queue"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "review_queue"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

human_decision_is_attributed.name: human_decision_is_attributed
human_decision_is_attributed.value:
"ai_suggestion"."status" NOT IN ('accepted', 'rejected')
          OR ("ai_suggestion"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_suggestion"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)
